stem: Two temperature scales, P and Q, are related linearly. A temperature that reads 20 degrees on scale P reads 50 degrees on scale Q, and a temperature that reads 70 degrees on scale P reads 150 degrees on scale Q. At what temperature reading do the two scales show the same number?
verify:
p, q = symbols('p q')
m = Rational(150 - 50, 70 - 20)
b = 50 - m*20
sol = solve(Eq(p, m*p + b), p)
assert sol == [-10]
assert [Rational(s) for s in spr_answers] == sol
